policy.resolution_rule: Admit only current official MAI/FED launch-page facts that are semantically consistent. AM1A1A and AM10B are admitted as OPEN using official status, deadline and beneficiary class. Budget is deliberately withheld because each launch page contains a material narrative-vs-summary currency/value conflict; UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN until reconciled from the signed specific guide.

evidence.source_owner: Ministerul Afacerilor Interne — Autoritatea de Management Afaceri Interne
evidence.semantic_assertion: The official MAI/FED launch page identifies AM1A1A as active, sets the submission deadline to 22 October 2026 at 16:00 and lists the eligible beneficiary class as Autoritate publică centrală. Budget is withheld because the same page states 85,462,836 lei in narrative text but 16,765,308 EUR in the summary.

evidence.source_owner: Ministerul Afacerilor Interne — Autoritatea de Management Afaceri Interne
evidence.semantic_assertion: The official MAI/FED launch page identifies AM10B as active, sets the submission deadline to 27 August 2027 at 16:00 and lists the eligible beneficiary class as Autoritate publică centrală. Budget is withheld because the same page states 4,000,000 lei in narrative text but 800,000 EUR in the summary.
